title: Which APIs do you use for live CFD/stock market data and X (Twitter) posts?
author: TensorTrader
selftext:
I know this question has probably been asked many times before. I’m currently building several experimental trading bots and I’m looking for reliable sources of live market data.

So - I am looking for:

* Live CFD price data
* Stock market data
* Potentially other financial/market data
* API access to posts/data from X (Twitter)

How are you guys handling this? Which APIs or data providers are you using?

I’m fine with paid services as well as long as the data quality reliability and API are quite good. I do not want to work inside a SaaS platform - because I have my own tools - so I need API access. 

Would be especially interested in recommendations from experienced people who are actually using these APIs for ai-trading, backtesting, sentiment analysis, or similar projects. 

Thanks you!

comments.author: tmemmg
comments.body: Unusual Whales. Just use the official X API.

comments.author: Amcvue2
comments.body: Yes please cheap. These api prices are out of control

comments.author: Training-Welder6866
comments.body: Check out dripstack.com for financial podcast and newsletter data. For example you can pull all stock picks from top newsletters and pods (burry, semianalysis, Alden, doomberg, etc) on a given day.
